An Award of Garden Merit-winning Exbury hybrid, Klondyke opens deep golden-orange flowers flushed bronze-red in bud, each truss centered with a darker orange-red flare, above bronze-red new foliage that matures to green. Fragrant and free-flowering in mid to late spring, it also offers reliable orange and red fall foliage color. Site it as a woodland-edge specimen or in a shade border, and keep the shallow root zone consistently moist and mulched, since deciduous azaleas resent both drought and waterlogged soil.
